purpose: Classify every direct @jhlagado/azm import outside packages/azm while Atom becomes the first-class assembler path. This is a migration control, not permission to add new AZM dependencies.

imports.retirement: Remove only after all supported assembly projects build through Atom or another non-AZM backend and the Debug80 release process no longer promises AZM compatibility.
Remove when Debug80 no longer ships or verifies the AZM compatibility backend.
Remove from this inventory only if the archived project is deleted or its bootstrap wrapper is rewritten; it is not part of the active Atom/Nucleus migration path.
Remove when the AZM headless integration package is retired or replaced by an Atom-headless integration package.

imports.owner: Atom CP/M-native strict contract artifact builder
imports.retirement: Replace when Atom has an independent contract checker for native Atom source or another checked path proves the CP/M image without translating through AZM.

imports.owner: Atom native-core byte and strict-contract oracle
imports.retirement: Replace when Atom self-host proof and register-contract proof no longer require AZM as the external strict-contract authority.
Replace after candidate measurement sources are either retired or measured through Atom plus an independent contract proof.

imports.owner: Atom native object harness strict-contract builder
imports.retirement: Replace when the native object harness can be built and contract-checked without AZM.
Remove when Atom no longer supports or verifies Atom-to-AZM translation.
Remove when the AZM-to-Atom migration bridge is no longer supported.
Replace when self-host proof no longer compares against an AZM-built oracle image.
Replace when the measured self-host path has a non-AZM baseline.
Remove after all Atom host tests stop using AZM as the byte-identity oracle.
Remove after Glimmer no longer supports AZM as a generated-Z80 backend.
Remove with Glimmer AZM backend support.
Remove or translate when Glimmer's checked generated assembly format becomes Atom-only.

imports.owner: Glimmer load/build tests with AZM backend coverage
imports.retirement: Remove with Glimmer AZM backend support.
Remove after the Atom-built proof images become authoritative and old AZM-built comparison images are no longer needed.

imports.owner: Nucleus canonical runtime image explicit AZM fallback
imports.retirement: Remove after the Atom runtime route is the only supported runtime provider and downstream callers no longer request the AZM fallback.

imports.owner: Nucleus proof harness legacy assembler and contract checker
imports.retirement: Remove after every non-measurement proof image has a permanent Atom route and strict contract verification no longer depends on AZM.
Remove after the migration bridge and AZM comparison path are retired.
Remove after AZM strict-contract sidecars and byte-identity checks are no longer required for CP/M development builds; Atom already supplies the packaged bytes and active D8 maps.
Remove after CP/M development proofs no longer need AZM strict-contract validation before Atom supplies executable bytes and D8 symbols.
Remove after the CP/M build pipeline has been converted to Atom or all remaining CP/M assembly blockers are tracked by a stronger migration gate.
Convert when the imported native Nucleus compiler image is built from Atom source.
